note: Telegram public-channel registry for the tg-corpus puller (kit/tools/tg_corpus.py). `official_status: unverified-self-claimed` means the channel displays a publisher name but no independent confirmation of who operates it was made at registration time — researchers must confirm before citing as that publisher (same discipline as any source). Candidates are unverified handles to check with `tg_corpus.py verify` before adding to `channels`.

pull_rules.web_preview_only: t.me/s/<channel> (no account, no API, no private groups, no comments)
pull_rules.corpus_stays_local: research/bangkok/corpus/telegram/ is git-ignored; bundles cite messages by canonical URL
pull_rules.politeness: ~1.2 s/page, bounded pages, failures logged once
